svg.title: Embrace, beat by beat
svg.text: Mayday's "Embrace", beat by beat: one box per beat
Chords and counts on top, strums in the middle, lyrics below; "·" means no word there, but strum anyway
74 BPM; strum ↓ - ↓↑ ↓ - ↓↑ (two boxes per group; the second is the empty swing back)
